dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the 2D geometric mass from the mid-dorsal region extending toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey median pixel intensity, categorized between slate dark-grey and mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, faint greyish mottling patches localized primarily along the anterior-dorsal surface and lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between slightly darker pigmented regions and the primary light-grey dorsal surface.
